decisions: Bind Design and Plan to the current Product controls: default graph depth 3; explicit traversal, fan-out, elapsed-time, correction, retry, and worker ceilings; no unnecessary whole-repository scan or ceremonial worker wave.

Count each logical attempt and provider-usage observation once across replay and duplicate events; retain source and cache semantics, report missing counters as unavailable rather than zero, and avoid storing full prompts or transcripts merely for accounting.
Give durable attempt artifacts and telemetry explicit retention, cleanup, and ownership rules while preserving required immutable history and accessible evidence.
Do not import the historical 12-hour or 28-runner-minute targets; any numeric delivery or CI budget requires a fresh measured baseline, owner, guardrail, and decision rule.
findings: The prior cost-lens result is not reusable unchanged: its 24h58m/13m10s baseline and 12-hour/28-runner-minute targets come from historical Design and Plan artifacts that the fresh Product specification explicitly excludes as current authority.

The current requirement still exposes material FinOps risk at source traversal, native worker fan-out and correction, replay accounting, durable evidence and telemetry growth, and provider-token cache semantics unless every spend multiplier is bounded and attributable.
